FN-11GTF3L-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 509
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Jeff Sorrells
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/28/2025
House Bill 509 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
State Veterinarian Office by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs associated with
establishing antemortem test standards and a minimum breeding value for cervids.
